definitions.binding_status: direct: own chromatin bond; indirect: protein-bond path to a directly bound molecule; free: no such path
definitions.pair_context: free_free / bound_free / bound_bound count zero / one / two partners with their own chromatin bond; indirect tethering is not direct binding
definitions.component_id: minimum member molecule ID in this frame; not an assembly lineage

transcription.rate_coupling: regulatory and mechanical state frozen during each reaction interval

warnings: Reduced units: time and length have not been calibrated to experimental measurements.
Independent drag omits hydrodynamics; soft repulsion permits occasional overlaps and chain crossings.
Binding and catalysis are phenomenological kinetics, not a detailed-balance calibrated equilibrium model.
Speckles and nucleoli are imposed stationary affinity fields; protein clusters assemble separately.
IDRs are coarse domain chains, not amino-acid-resolved proteins; their input D is free molecule COM diffusion.
No physical unit mapping is attached; model values remain in reduced units.

metadata.replay: Configuration and seed reproduce an initial run; state is an inspection snapshot, not a restart checkpoint.

backends.detail: NumPy Brownian reference engine · local CPU

OpenMM 8.6.1; polychrom 0.1.1; platforms: Reference, CPU, OpenCL. Registered platforms only; device initialization has not been tested. Real Brownian integration; CPU forces and reactions, with transfers every substep.

capabilities.host_device_transfer: positions, forces, and mobilities every substep

limitations: Dynamics are stored in reduced units. Physical interpretation requires a documented length scale and an MSD-derived clock; attaching a mapping does not validate the biological model.
Speckles and nucleoli are imposed stationary affinity fields. Protein assemblies can form independently; nucleolar subphases and rRNA processing are not modeled.
IDRs are explicit domain-bead sticker chains, not residue-level or sequence-parametrized CALVADOS proteins.
Independent particle drag omits hydrodynamic coupling; soft excluded volume can allow chain crossings.
Histone marks are independent binary flags per bead; a nucleosome-unit bead can carry these flags but does not resolve histone tails, individual residues, or wrapped DNA.
Regulatory gains and state-selective chromatin attraction are configurable hypotheses; protein preferences are encounter multipliers, not measured dissociation constants.
Transcription-dependent persistence and processing enhancement are configurable hypotheses, not universal biological laws.
Assembly and gene parameters are illustrative. Seeing a cluster is not evidence of calibrated liquid-liquid phase separation.

cluster.acceleration: OpenMM integration only; forces, reactions and RNA remain on CPU.
